---
title: "History"
subtitle: "Source-based reconstruction — one cited chapter, four placeholders"
---

The commissioning brief suggested this working lineage so later evidence has a place to land:

**institutional or agency care → disability-led independent-living experiments → Creekview → Enhanced Consumer Participation Model (ECPM) → direct individualized funding → CSIL design and pilot → a province-wide program.**

That sentence remains a **research proposition**. The [Creekview chapter](creekview.qmd) now reconstructs the 1980s project from inspected sources. It does **not** treat Creekview as a proven predecessor of ECPM or CSIL. The other chapters are still placeholders.

| Working date | Chapter | Status on this site |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Early 1980s | Independent-living / community-living advocacy in British Columbia | Context now summarized from Haw 1989 on the Creekview page; no separate origins narrative |
| c. 1984–89 | [Creekview](creekview.qmd) | Cited chapter (Hansard 1984 and 1986; Haw 1989; 1987 abstract; later SCI BC / Fayerman accounts) |
| c. 1987 | Creekview evaluation | Evaluation attested; report copy not held; Ryan authorship unconfirmed |
| c. 1990 | ECPM material and *Keys on Freedom* | 1990 ECPM manual independently cited; *Keys on Freedom* still unconfirmed |
| c. 1993 | CSIL design / authorization | Contested with 1994 |
| c. 1994 | CSIL pilot; possible ECPM training revision | Contested with 1993; 1994 revision unfound |
| c. 1995 | Province-wide availability | Later official chronology (Ombudsperson 2012); 1995 HEU still says “pilot” |

: Working dates and reconstruction status for history chapters
